title.value: Information Theoretical Study on Neural Learning Processes

abstract.value: In this paper, we reveal how deep networks converge over data flows in their training process via an information theoretical analysis. By looking into individual neurons in different layers, we found that the whole learning process of neural networks are pertinent to the local flows per individual neurons in various layers.
